d:
Vishal and Swati, his wife, move into a highrise apartment where she gets possessed by a vengeful spirit. However, Vishal must help rid his wife of the spirit possessing her before it is too late.
Bhoot is a 2003 Indian Hindi-language supernatural horror film directed by Ram Gopal Varma.
The film stars Ajay Devgn, Urmila Matondkar, Nana Patekar, Rekha, Tanuja and Fardeen Khan.
The film was perceived to be different from a typical Hindi film as it did not feature the songs composed for it. The film was a box-office hit.
Music of the film was composed by Salim Sulaiman.
